messages:
support-agent: Heads-up — customer ticket #4521 escalated: p99 latency for text-gen jumped from ~320ms to ~1.2s after last runtime deploy. They see timeouts on long prompts. https://tickets.internal/4521 :alarm_clock:
marie: Ugh. Which deploy went out and what changed?
support-agent: Deploy ID deploy-2026-04-12-13:10 (canary->prod). Observed p95 470ms -> 820ms, p99 320ms -> 1.2s between 13:12-13:40. Affects model rwd-7b-seq2.
tim: That deploy included a compile flag update (ENABLE_FLASHATTN=1) and a new kernel selection heuristic. I suspected perf wins but maybe regressed for long sequences.
sanjay: Can someone paste a quick repro curl so I can repro locally? Need model, seq len, and a sample prompt.
support-agent: Repro curl: ```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-seq2","input":"'"long prompt..."'","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
``` Sequence len ~1k tokens in their pipeline.
alyssa: On our infra the kernel chooser log shows: ```kernel-chooser: model=rwd-7b-seq2 seq_len=1024 -> selected=flash_attn_v2 priority=0.8``` but the host also logged GPU stalls.
tim: Interesting — flash_attn_v2 was chosen but its masking path performs worse for very long recurrences. Could be kernel microbench mismatch for long seq + batch variety.
sanjay: I ran a repro on a dev node. With ENABLE_FLASHATTN=1 p99 ~1.1s, with ENABLE_FLASHATTN=0 p99 ~350ms. Quick mitigation is to fallback to SDPA kernels for long sequences.
support-agent: Customer accepted a temporary workaround if we can drop them to the previous variant.
marie: Can ops force a kernel override per model until we ship a fix? e.g., env KERNEL_PREF=sdpa or force kernel_selector override in rollout config.
alyssa: Yes, Console -> Model routing -> add override for rwd-7b-seq2: kernel_preference=[sdpa, flash_attn] and move 100% traffic to that variant. I'll do it now. :clock1:
deploy-bot: rollout started: override/rwd-7b-seq2 -> sdpa (100%) by alyssa at 2026-04-12T13:55Z
oncall-bot: paging oncall (sanjay) — customer 4521 experiencing P99 > 1s.
sanjay: After override, observed p99 drop to ~380ms in prod aggregates within 2 min. We'll keep it for 1h and then plan a fix.
tim: Root cause plan: revert ENABLE_FLASHATTN compile flag for rwd-7b-seq2 in next hotfix build, re-run kernel microbench on long-seq scenarios, and update kernel selection heuristic to prefer sdpa for seq_len>768 until flash_attn is validated.
marie: Also add an automated canary test that runs 1k-token prompts against new kernels before rollout. Ticketed as INF-788.
support-agent: Customer notified and happy with workaround for now. Leaving ticket open until hotfix lands.
alyssa: Logging follow-up: I saved kernel chooser traces and GPU nvprof snippets to s3://ci-artifacts/INF-788/ for the fix.
marie: Thanks all — assign owners: tim (fix build flags + microbench), sanjay (canary test + rollout policy), alyssa (override + traces). Update INF-788 with status. :thumbsup:
support-agent: marking ticket 4521 as "mitigated (temp)" and will update once fix deployed.
marie: Closing loop: please post a short postmortem in #postmortems once INF-788 is resolved.
__notes: Generated Slack thread about p99 latency regression tied to FlashAttention kernel selection and compile flag; includes repro, mitigation, and owner assignments. All fields are strings or arrays of strings as required.
